0.msg: Hello there, #b#h0##k. I've heard Tangyoon was looking for you. He's the chef on the Nautilus, in case you forgot.

1.msg: My hopes and dreams are shattered. Monsters have stolen all of the chicken I made for the crew.

2.msg: Do you know what happens when a pirate crew gets hungry?! They get hungry. And when the hunger hits you at sea, even your wonderful chef starts to look like a five course feast.

3.msg: I don't want to get eaten, #b#h0##k! Can you help me out for a couple of weeks? I'd just need about #r10 days#k of help to get back on track.

4.msg: You have to help. I'll pay you! A lot!

0.msg: That's too bad. Come back and see me if you change your mind.

Thank you very much, #b#h0##k! Just make sure to hit that little star-shaped thingy on the left there when you come back every day. You're looking for this: #i3800423#. Let's do some good work over the next couple of weeks!

1.msg: Good! Use the attendance log in the star shaped icon on the left side of the screen or speak to Cassandra when you are ready.
